patch_description: Consolidate the pre- and post-entanglement RZ rotations into a single shared parameter, exactly as was done in the high-scoring second program (0.72 score). The second program achieved superior performance by reducing parameters from 20 to 14 through this consolidation while maintaining perfect accuracy and zero generalization gap. The current RX-based ansatz uses the separated pre/post structure (like the lower-scoring first program), so applying the same consolidation strategy should yield similar improvements. This targets parameter economy—the dominant factor in the combined score—without sacrificing accuracy.
